examples.ja: 芳田氏は山形県に生まれ、日本大学芸術学部油絵科を卒業する。
examples.en: Mr Yoshida was born in Yamagata prefecture, and graduated from Nihon University College of Art with a degree in oil painting.

examples.ja: 大抵の学芸は、最初に基礎をしっかりやっておかないと、その先スムーズに身に付けることができません。
examples.en: With most of the arts, if you don't get the basics down properly then it is difficult to acquire further skills.
